notes: The projection carries six generations and the ASV five: τοῦ Ἀδμίν stands unrepresented under rule 97's mirror case, kept as two units under rule 2 rather than one, and the empty pair is correctly s003/s004, the article immediately preceding Ἀδμίν.
The ASV's own note (many ancient authorities insert the son of Admin) corroborates but does not by itself license the status; the notes carry the unit id as rule 97 requires.
A reference comparison will report both tokens as disagreements, and that report is not a correction.
